description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Sakura-Tribe Elder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Sakura-Tribe Elder, untapping the basic Swamp.
Activate Sakura-Tribe Elder by sacrificing it.
Repeat.
